verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships 'Loop,' a built-in AI agent that lets users investigate logs via natural language and auto-build scorers, datasets, and dashboards, and 'Patterns' which runs Loop autonomously against trace backlogs to surface issues and fixes. This directly matches delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Loop's capabilities and depth (all evidence is first-party docs), and more detail on the scope/limits of what tasks can be delegated.
